_source: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage (DPPQS), Statistical Database, ppqs.gov.in/statistical-database: state-wise consumption and demand of chemical and bio-pesticides, and pesticide-wise consumption of indigenous pesticides, from States/UTs' reports on inputs of plant protection.

_units.chemical: tonnes (technical grade/formulation, as reported by states)

_notes: NR (not reported) is left out, never counted as zero; national totals are DPPQS's own.
Demand is in tonnes of formulation and use mixes technical grade and formulation, so the two are not compared.
Pesticide-wise 2025-26 covers 16 States/UTs (Agenda Report on Plant Protection, kharif 2026); 2024-25 is the latest complete year.
